gaps.sentence: Please carry ___ with your work; don't mind me.
gaps.explanation: carry on = continue; carry out = perform (a task).

gaps.sentence: Who is going to deal ___ the angry customer?
gaps.explanation: deal with = handle; deal in = trade.

gaps.sentence: I ran ___ my old teacher at the airport.
gaps.explanation: run into somebody = meet them by chance (also: bump into).

gaps.sentence: The factory laid ___ two hundred workers.
gaps.explanation: lay off = dismiss workers because there is not enough work.

gaps.sentence: A new proposal was put ___ at the meeting.
gaps.explanation: put forward = propose, suggest (an idea, plan, name).

gaps.sentence: The new law will phase ___ disposable plastics by 2030.
gaps.explanation: phase out = gradually stop using something.

gaps.sentence: I came ___ an old letter while clearing the attic.
She cheered ___ when she heard the news.
gaps.explanation: cheer up = become happier (also transitive: cheer somebody up).
